question: Does joint (q0, omega) LM polish on the top-50 surrogate-MSE survivors of seed 89 bridge the off-circle floor into the truth basin?
hypothesis: LM polish bridges the residual ~8deg off-circle gap into surrogate Band A.
narrative_md: Joint LM polish (scipy least_squares, method='lm', surrogate-MSE objective) on the top-50 surrogate-MSE survivors from s033's seed-89 pool. Decisive positive: best polished candidate predicted rho 0.37 (Band A), q0->truth 0.86deg, omega-dir 0.11deg, omega-mag -0.02% — basin hit. 24/50 polished into surrogate Band A in ~5 min. First end-to-end refutation of the 'framework structurally constrained' reading. Hi-fi confirmation pending (s035).
